entries.desc: abi version gate; returns 2 — the module imports the abi=2 cam family only (cam_frame_get carries w/h out with the frame; zero retired camera_* names in the import table)

linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal; larger bumps return heap_buf-based addresses (P3-T2 rider: the bare-offset era handed out .rodata-range offsets and heap_buf was optimized away)

one QVGA frame -> lit regions sorted by area desc, capped at max_regions. cfg (all optional, unknown keys ignored): threshold 0..255 (default 128, lit = luma >= threshold), min_area (default 16), max_regions 1..32 (default 8), discard_first (default true: consume one frame first for AWB convergence — stateless, exactly two cam_frame_get calls). Means are integers 0..255 (no floats in the abi=1 value bridge); luma = BT.601 integer approx (77R+150G+29B)>>8 with 5/6-bit components replicated to 8 bits. Camera must be on at QVGA (caller's responsibility); camera-off or larger framesizes raise the host's rt exception. Behavior byte-identical to 1.0.0 — the only change is the abi=2 import face (cam_frame_get carries geometry; camera_info retired), recompiled for the abi=2 host table.

ops.name: analyze
ops.semantics: one QVGA frame → lit regions sorted by area (largest first), capped at max_regions; cfg (all optional, unknown keys ignored): threshold 0..255 default 128 (lit = luma >= threshold), min_area default 16 (smaller regions dropped), max_regions 1..32 default 8, discard_first default true (consume one frame first — unconverged AWB after camera-on; stateless: exactly two cam_frame_get calls per analyze)
